title: 18975 - 18975/P2543
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Failed Lift Pump in Fuel Tank
technicalNotes: When found on FSI engines, MVB 106.2 shows the duty cycle of the lift pump, this value should be below 60% at idle.  The higher the number, the more the lift pump has to run to maintain fuel pressure to the High Pressure Fuel Pump.
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
